description: Synthetic iterate-mode inputs for contract-agent. Each scenario references a prior fresh-mode fixture in chat/tests/two-agent/fixtures/ as the prior_contract, then synthesizes a failure_description that the runtime would produce after a smoke-test failure on that contract. probe-iterate.js feeds these to the live contract-agent and saves the iterate-mode output for inspection.

scenarios.description: Frontend calls an endpoint the backend never declared. Single-scope (backend) fix.
scenarios.failure_description: Smoke test failed on the policy-search flow. The frontend SearchBar component issues GET /api/policies/search?q=<term> but the backend returns 404. Inspecting api_contract: no /policies/search endpoint declared. Backend code only implements /policies (GET, POST) and /policies/:id (GET, PUT, DELETE). The search endpoint is missing entirely. Only the backend scope needs to change.

scenarios.description: Backend and frontend disagree on a query param name. Could be either scope; planner picks one.
scenarios.failure_description: Smoke failed on contract upload flow. Frontend POSTs to /api/documents with body { contractText: '...' } but the backend declares the field as { content: '...' } in api_contract. 400 on every upload. The fix is a single field-name reconciliation — either the frontend or the backend changes to match the other. Pick one scope and emit a diff.

scenarios.description: Business logic references a column that data_model never declared. Two-scope fix (database + backend).
scenarios.failure_description: Smoke failed. The audit-log feature in business_logic_contract.side_effects writes audit_log.actor_id but data_model.tables[audit_log] has columns [id, action, target_id, timestamp] — actor_id is missing. The trigger in business_logic_contract.triggers also references this column. Both the database schema and the backend logic need updating.
